<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

nltl:TRF035ShipShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property nltl:TRF035RuleLengthPropertyShape ;
    sh:property nltl:TRF035ClassificationSocietyRuleLengthPropertyShape ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:prefixes [
            a sh:PrefixDeclaration ;
            sh:declare [
                a sh:PrefixDeclaration ;
                sh:prefix "nltl" ;
                sh:namespace "https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#"
            ] ;
            sh:declare [
                a sh:PrefixDeclaration ;
                sh:prefix "qudt" ;
                sh:namespace "http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/"
            ] ;
            sh:declare [
                a sh:PrefixDeclaration ;
                sh:prefix "xsd" ;
                sh:namespace "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
            ]
        ] ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ruleLength> ?ruleQuantity .
                ?ruleQuantity <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/numericValue> ?ruleValue .
                $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#classificationSocietyRuleLength> ?societyQuantity .
                ?societyQuantity <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/numericValue> ?societyValue .
                FILTER ( ?ruleValue != ?societyValue )
            }
        """ ;
        sh:message "The numeric value of nltl:ruleLength must equal the numeric value of nltl:classificationSocietyRuleLength; both quantities must be expressed in canonical metres." ;
        sh:description "Represents the condition in TRAFICOM 2021 regulation clause 4.1.1 that L is to be taken as the ship's rule length used by the classification society. No tolerance or unit conversion is introduced."
    ] ;
    sh:description "Activated constraint for the caller-admitted complete population of nltl:ship records. The represented source requirement is: \"L shall be taken as the ship's rule length used by the classification society.\" The caller supplies external research-scope eligibility and the selected 2021 source edition; those assumptions are not independently re-certified by this shape." ;
    sh:message "TRF-035 clause 4.1.1 requires the ship's ruleLength to equal the separately supplied classificationSocietyRuleLength reference quantity." ;
    sh:order 35 .

nltl:TRF035RuleLengthPropertyShape
    a sh:PropertyShape ;
    sh:path nltl:ruleLength ;
    sh:minCount 1 ;
    sh:node nltl:TRF035LengthQuantityShape ;
    sh:description "The direct ship-owned quantity representing L, the rule length used by the design." .

nltl:TRF035ClassificationSocietyRuleLengthPropertyShape
    a sh:PropertyShape ;
    sh:path nltl:classificationSocietyRuleLength ;
    sh:minCount 1 ;
    sh:node nltl:TRF035LengthQuantityShape ;
    sh:description "The direct ship-owned classification-society reference quantity against which ruleLength is compared. The source does not provide a separately enforceable society identity or derivation procedure; no such obligation is added." .

nltl:TRF035LengthQuantityShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
    sh:property nltl:TRF035NumericValuePropertyShape ;
    sh:property nltl:TRF035UnitPropertyShape ;
    sh:description "Canonical quantity representation required by the declared JSON-LD serialization: one decimal numericValue and one canonical metre unit." .

nltl:TRF035NumericValuePropertyShape
    a sh:PropertyShape ;
    sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
    sh:minCount 1 ;
    sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
    sh:description "Numeric component of the quantity, encoded as xsd:decimal according to the declared quantityEncoding.numeric_predicate." .

nltl:TRF035UnitPropertyShape
    a sh:PropertyShape ;
    sh:path qudt:unit ;
    sh:minCount 1 ;
    sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:hasValue <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M> ;
    sh:description "Unit component of the quantity, required to be the canonical metre IRI according to the declared quantityEncoding.unit_predicate." .

nltl:TRF035SourceEvidence
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:description "Source evidence retained for TRF-035: data/requirements/TRAFICOM_full.txt; document SHA-256 e0bf179c97a1535aa7d4d0dd5d4053edf5f3f4e7e028c49d14c3a31cc7c1e8ba; selected clause 4.1.1 character offsets 42109-43429; selection SHA-256 bcccb0c27b3065f7270ed4809b69f39fcbcc051291a324f43641bf09a19a7c90. The selected text states: \"L shall be taken as the ship's rule length used by the classification society.\" Source-edition applicability and population eligibility are caller-admitted research assumptions, not independently verified legal findings. The source selection manifest records other unresolved references in the broader document; none is silently used to expand this clause's represented obligation." .
<END_SHACL>
